option_assessment.reason: A full report would mix repair semantics, Writer quality and delivery controls before the new accepted-evidence branch has any natural observation.
Demand evidence-role and numeric-view behavior already have natural observations; another demand call has little marginal information value.
The deterministic planner already compiles 38 cells and five canonical repair requests. The unresolved risk is repair adjudication, not another free-form plan.
One fixed-pack call can test accepted Evidence, partial gap closure, exact affected-cell scope, mechanism, boundary and WWC without source access or full-report cost.
Campaign behavior belongs after one changed contract family is naturally qualified and would otherwise duplicate the later three-case dynamic Agentic Research step.

pass_disposition: After zero-call implementation and clean proof, make a separate exact-once live authority decision, issue and execute at most one DeepSeek Pro call. A natural pass may authorize one repaired DELL fixed-pack report, but does not itself pass S3.
fail_disposition: Preserve the capture and stop with zero retry. If the typed repair semantics fail, reduce this surface to smaller model judgment atoms plus deterministic state assembly; do not add DeepSeek-specific field-by-field branches and do not run a full report.
known_boundary: This is a zero-call value, cost and risk decision. It does not prove natural DeepSeek behavior, register a live scope, issue or consume an admission, call a Provider, repair the DELL report, close S1 gaps, pass S3, grant qualified-human or Owner acceptance, or authorize release.
